text:
**Card spending:** Monzo doesn’t charge a foreign-transaction fee. It converts purchases at Mastercard’s exchange rate.

**Cash withdrawals:** You get a fee-free allowance, then Monzo charges **3%** on withdrawals over it. For a standard personal account, the allowance depends on whether Monzo is your main bank and where you’re withdrawing:

- **In the UK or EEA:** unlimited if Monzo is your main bank; otherwise, £400 every 30 days.
- **Outside the EEA:** £200 every 30 days.

Your 30-day allowance resets based on when you withdraw, not at the start of each calendar month. Some ATMs may also charge their own fee. ([Monzo’s fee guide](https://monzo.com/help/account-and-profile/understanding-fees))
